disposition_scope: Automated prototype-release signal diagnostics with explicit uncertainty. This is not a French pronunciation/CEFR certificate or a human listening review.
secondary_model: OpenAI Whisper base, CTranslate2 via faster-whisper 1.2.1

signal_method.method: 5 formants below 5500 Hz, 25-ms analysis half-window, 5-ms steps, 50-Hz preemphasis; median around max 30-ms RMS energy
signal_method.interpretation: Descriptive acoustic differences independently extracted from WAVs. No thresholds fitted or pass/fail labels assigned.
limitations: Peak-energy windows are reproducible sampling, not certified phoneme boundaries.
Automatic LPC formant estimates can mistrack; no physiological or phoneme-identity certification is claimed.
Onset energy is a rough voicing cue and can include transitions; it does not replace actual phonetic alignment.

repairs: tout/doux and gâche/cache did not distinguish both labels in independent constrained ASR; replaced by fin/vin and belle/bulle.
Elle lit le livre... replaced by Elle ouvre le livre... after two independent recognizers disagreed on lit.
Audio-check sentence changed to Bonjour. Vous êtes prêt à écouter du français., recognized exactly by both models.
Nous avons reporté la réunion... replaced by La réunion est reportée... to remove an agreed spurious à; target faute de temps independently identified.
media_build_manifest_note: Hash of the media-build manifest before attaching these diagnostic dispositions; audio byte hashes below are authoritative. This avoids a circular audit/manifest hash.
